capabilities: Render inline dice formulas as clickable, rerollable results in Live Preview and Reading view
Roll dice notation with modifiers, success counting, flags and saved named formulas
Roll rows from Markdown tables by block id, heading or note link
Write dice-mod roll results into the note in a single undoable step
Keep a sidebar roll history and roll arbitrary formulas in a dialog
extras: Does not support Dice Roller's section, tag, line, Dataview, narrative or 3D dice; those stay as plain code so Dice Roller can remain installed for them. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: reads the dice formulas of Dice Roller, with the same dice: syntax, modifiers and flags
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to roll dice inside notes, and existing dice rollers rewrite notes unexpectedly or lack a roll history.

relations.evidence: This plugin reads the dice formulas of Dice Roller, with the same dice: syntax, modifiers and flags

summary: Inline dice-roll plugin that turns dice: formulas into clickable results in notes, with a roll dialog, roll history and Dice Roller-compatible notation.
